checks: The look fixture saves
House dark, the default, keeps the look out of hotkey-wheel.json
The footer starts with Look: House
The sun and moon switch saves light panels at once
Look: House switches to the Minecraft look and saves it
The Minecraft look has no colour or light switch
Cancel in the editor keeps the look chosen in it
Save keeps the look chosen while editing
Choosing a colour from the list saves it at once
The default colour is left out of the file again
